## Checklist
- [ ] `shellcheck launcher/bin/gbp launcher/scripts/build.sh` passes
- [ ] Works with the stock macOS bash 3.2 (`/bin/bash`)

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
